When NASA intentionally crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid, it punched a stadium-sized crater into the space rock. But what if a real threat headed toward Earth and we had to deflect it? Using a kinetic impactor means slamming a massive probe into the asteroid at thousands of miles per hour, altering its orbital path just enough to miss our planet completely. It is planetary defense in action. Would you trust a robotic probe to save Earth? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: Hera spacecraft gets 1st up-close look at stadium-sized hole punched in asteroid by NASA DART mission
